checks: The viewer is the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: role tree with a name, rows are treeitems
The root row: level 1, 1 of 1, expanded, selected, active, and the only tabbable row
Rows read like the preview: "KB001: 20260930" for a value, "CNTCTD, array, 1 item" for a branch
A child: level 2, "1 of 5", no aria-expanded on a value, indent through --level, 30 px high
Values carry their type: strings, numbers, booleans and null have data-type, strings in double quotes
The tree has the toolbar, the path bar and a status region
The path bar shows the current row: "report" and "object, 5 keys"
Clicking a branch opens it and makes it the current row
A branch unfolds each row on a spring: heights over 61 frames follow stiffness 220, damping 32 (rmse 0.9% of a row; the recording itself fits at 1.5%)
Rows settle at 30 px with overflow visible, as in the preview
ArrowDown moves to the next visible row and focuses it
End jumps to the last visible row, Home to the first
Home jumps back to the root
ArrowLeft closes an open branch (the root)
ArrowRight opens a closed branch
ArrowRight on an open branch moves into it
ArrowLeft on a value moves to its parent
Enter toggles a branch
Space toggles it back
"/" focuses the search field
Search counts its matches as "1/N" in a live region (1/130) and the first match is the current row
The matches are marked, the current one stronger
Search opened every branch that holds a match
Enter jumps to the next match and the counter follows (2/130; report.CNTCTD[0].KHACHHANG[0].THONGTINBD[0].TS013 -> report.CNTCTD[0].KHACHHANG[0].THONGTINBD[1].TS013)
Shift+Enter goes back
ArrowDown in the search moves focus into the tree
Escape in the search clears the query and the matches block leaves
A search with no match says 0/0 and disables previous and next
Collapse all leaves the root open and the current row on it
A long array shows its first page and a "Show 50 more, 80 hidden" row (level, 51 of 51)
The row says what it will do and what is left
Enter on it loads the next page: the last 30 are what is left
The last page is only what is left, and then the row is gone
Row copy buttons are out of the tab order and appear on hover
Copying swaps the glyph to a check and the label to "Copied" (done)
What was copied is the value as it is, and a status region announces it
After 1.4 s the button is back to idle
Ctrl+C copies the current value
Ctrl+Shift+C copies its path
The path bar copies the path of the current row
The highlight glides to the next row on a spring instead of jumping (28 frames, 30 px, rmse 3.1%; recording 0.15%)
The workflow card is the preview's: a labelled section, an ordered list of steps on a rail, a header with Run and a footer
Each step is a real result: 9 checks inside the steps, each with its own state
A step that failed says why, and offers where to fix it
The step that was timed shows the milliseconds the worker took, the others say "Done"
The branch has tabs (Ready, Blocked) as a radio group, the taken path selected
Switching the path crossfades its body and moves the tab highlight
A run moves one thing at a time: a dot travels each connector, then one step runs, then it is done (237 frames, dot seen true, most steps running at once 1)
The run ends (aria-busy off) with every step settled and none still running
The dot takes 240 ms per connector (measured 242, 241, 244 ms)
The footer says how the run ended, and a live region announced it
With reduced motion the rows open at once: full height in the first frame
With reduced motion a run has no travelling dot, and still ends with the same states
390: the viewer fits the screen and the indent drops to 12 px
390: the workflow card fits and its rows grow to 44 px (container query)
320: the viewer fits the screen and the indent drops to 12 px
320: the workflow card fits and its rows grow to 44 px (container query)
No browser errors
Nothing left the page while the viewer and the pipeline ran
